reason: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and I do the price-per-day math on everything. Even the $24.99 launch price is not a steal for a month of one thing, and I forget my vitamins half the time anyway.
objection: I can get magnesium at a lower price per day elsewhere, and I have no proof this one is worth the extra. The lab report is nice, but I'm not paying a premium to carry it in a pocket.
would_change_my_mind: A real flash sale or coupon that brings a month down to around $15 to $18, or a free first box with a subscription I can cancel.
